## Discrimination

Pupils were asked whether they had faced discrimination, answering the question "How often do people make you feel bad because of:", and presented with a range of options.
Percentages of pupils who answered "Often or always" or "Some of the time" are shown by cause in Figure \@ref(fig:bar-face-discrimination).

```{r bar-face-discrimination, fig.cap = "% of pupils who have experienced discrimination, by cause"}
input_data |>
  summary_proportions_multiple(
    varslist = list(
      disc1_5 = "Religion/Faith",
      disc1_4 = "Disability",
      disc1_3 = "Sexual Orientation",
      disc1_2 = "Gender",
      disc1_1 = "Race, skin colour, or where they were born"
    ),
    success = ~ .x %in% c("Often or always", "Some of the time"),
    genders = genders,
    classes = list(unlist(classes)),
    .gender_split = TRUE
  ) |>
  map(censor_summary_data, "numerator") |>
  map(bar_proportions_multiple) |>
  patchwork::align_patches() |> 
  print_first_graph() 
```

Figure \@ref(fig:bar-face-discrimination-by-class) shows proportions who have faced any discrimination, by class.


```{r bar-face-discrimination-by-class, fig.cap="% of pupils who have experienced discrimination, by class"}

input_data |>
  mutate(discrimination = if_any(starts_with("disc1"), ~.x %in% c("Often or always", "Some of the time"))) |> 
  create_collapsed_summary(
    discrimination,
    success = TRUE,
    genders,
    classes,
    .gender_split = TRUE
  ) |>
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum), .by = class) |> 
  mutate(gender = "All") |> 
  censor_summary_data("numerator") |>
  bar_from_summary()

```


`r if (place_q) "Pupils who reported facing discrimination were asked where this had occurred. Percentages of pupils facing discrimination by place of discrimination are shown in Figure \\@ref(fig:bar-place-discrimination)."`

```{r bar-place-discrimination, fig.cap="% of pupils who face discrimination by place of discrimination", eval = place_q}
input_data |>
  mutate(discrimination = if_any(starts_with("disc1"), ~.x %in% c("Often or always", "Some of the time"))) |> 
  filter(discrimination) |> 
  mutate(across(starts_with("disc2"), ~as.character(is.na(.x)))) |> 
  rename_with(~stringr::str_replace_all(.x, "[^a-z0-9_]", ""), starts_with("disc2")) |> 
  summary_proportions_multiple(
    varslist = list(
      `disc2_6` = "Online",
      `disc2_5` = "In my local area",
      `disc2_3` = "At school",
      `disc2_3` = "On public transport",
      `disc2_2` = "Walking to or from school",
      `disc2_1` = "At home"
    ),
    success = ~ as.logical(.x),
    genders = genders,
    classes = list(unlist(classes)),
    .gender_split = TRUE
  ) |>
  map(censor_summary_data, "numerator") |>
  map(bar_proportions_multiple) |>
  patchwork::align_patches() |> 
  print_first_graph() 
```
